results.title: Weber County Judge Fights to Keep Seat After Utah's Only Negative Review
results.description: Utah's Judicial Performance Evaluation Commission says Weber County Justice Court Judge Trent Nelson should go. He's asking voters to decide instead.

results.title: Trump Rips Judge Overseeing Charlie Kirk Murder Trial
results.description: President Donald Trump is not happy with the judge overseeing the Charlie Kirk murder trial. On his Truth Social account, Trump blasted Utah District Court Judge Tony Graf for saying he would hold a hearing to consider delaying the trial of Tyler Robinson until 2029.
